verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes a financial-model acceptance condition requiring the need for availability-style payments to be substantiated through project viability and bankability outputs.

The client authorizes the proposed model build and reiterates the availability-payment viability objective, accepting the preceding concrete Case A and Case B comparison structure; the delivery deadline is correctly excluded.
The client adds an explicit model acceptance condition that the user-funded case must demonstrate that user fees alone cannot produce a viable and bankable project.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim that the delivered model contains separate cash flows for both funding scenarios; it does not constitute runtime verification.
